fields.label: Enable E-GP Connector
fields.description: Master switch for the connector. Leave unchecked to use the app as manual records only.

fields.label: Supplier Registration URL
fields.description: Deep link to the E-GP supplier registration module.

fields.label: API Gateway Endpoint
fields.description: E-GP does not publish a public REST API. Point this at a gateway/middleware endpoint (yours or National Treasury's, when available) that exposes tender/supplier data in the app's expected JSON shape. See docs/11-procurement-egp.md.

fields.label: API Token / Key
fields.description: Bearer token for the gateway endpoint. Stored as a password field; never leaves the system.

fields.label: Synchronise Tenders
fields.description: Pull tender notices from the gateway and mirror them as Tender records.

fields.label: Synchronise Supplier Status
fields.description: Refresh supplier E-GP registration status against the gateway.
